While it cannot be used to pierce the veil within Icecrown Citadel, you should be able to use it to discern something of value so that we will know how best to proceed.

texts.text0_0: Archmage Vargoth enstrusted me with his staff when he told me to flee from the blood elf attack on Violet Tower. I did as he told me, hoping to take refuge in the old draenei settlement of Arklon.$B$BThere was to be no respite. I had walked right into the leading edge of a Burning Legion force. The demons wrested the staff from me, but I managed to escape with my life.$B$BThough my master knows nothing of my failure, it still shames me.
